title: Tangential divergence through an injective parametrization differential
statement: For all n, N ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝᴺ, y ∈ ℝᴺ, every map Y : ℝᴺ → ℝᴺ and every injective continuous linear map A : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ with tangentSpace M y = range A: tangentialDivergence M Y y = trace(G⁻¹ ∘ A* ∘ DY(y) ∘ A), the trace of an endomorphism of ℝⁿ, where DY(y) := fderiv ℝ Y y, A* := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A and G⁻¹ := Ring.inverse (A* ∘ A). No differentiability of Y is assumed (both sides only involve the linear map fderiv ℝ Y y).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (y : Rn N) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N) (Y : Rn N → Rn N), Function.Injective A → tangentSpace M y = LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap → tangentialDivergence M Y y = LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L A) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L fderiv ℝ Y y ∘L A).toLinearMap
